purpose: Independent current-state audit of the evidence registry, crosswalks, and post-fit gates. This artifact is diagnostic and does not promote, demote, or overwrite a registry packet.

pre_fit_status.interpretation: The evidence and mapping contracts are closed sufficiently to run mechanistic and aggregate-supervised training. The 88 unresolved mappings are validation-only or rejected packets, not required training rows; they must not be silently promoted.

post_fit_status.interpretation: The reported 1.0 mechanistic coverage is an aggregate interval/one-sided inequality gate, not location-level historical accuracy. The residual challengers fail the interval gate and do not replace the mechanistic baseline.

two_sided_groups.assessment: Retain as the strongest fertile, locally provisioned agrarian interval. Rich-loam and crisis/pressure evidence is substantive, but the Derville/Fossier bundle is one source family and should not be treated as an independent global replication.

Retain as the primary scale-calibration context and an interval anchor. It shares geography and some Campbell/manorial inputs with the England scale record; those records must be grouped for holdouts and not counted as independent evidence.
Retain as a hostile-island interval. The companion Iceland biomass floor uses the same Haraldsson/Ice-CC model family and is a corroborating lower bound, not an independent replication.

Scale anchor only; it has no independent capacity interval in the registry. Its source_family_independence metadata is missing and it overlaps the England food interval. Do not use it as a second two-sided training target.

strong_lower_bound_groups.assessment: Strong hydraulic/rice local-food lower bound; exact ~3000 km2 boundary and current mechanistic prediction passes, but the archaeological city/landscape estimate remains one-sided.
Contiguous register lower bound; 95 years late, with under-registration and famine caveats.
Retain as one grouped lower-bound family, not eleven independent anchors; rice-only/partial-register semantics prevent a ceiling.
Strong local-food island lower bound; late date and conquest/modorra shocks prevent two-sided use.
Useful pressure floor, but grain exports/internal trade mean no autarkic ceiling.
Good local land/pasture floor; marine foods prevent a closed upper interval.
Published irrigation/canal carrying-capacity floor; source corridor is narrower than the containing EU5 selector.

coverage_audit.interpretation: The machine crosswalk contract is closed, but a high coverage fraction on a containing EU5 location is not the same as exact historical-boundary equivalence. The five records above require conservative one-sided semantics.

conclusion.why: All 28 required evidence/crosswalk rows are resolved, the mechanistic pre-fit contract is complete, and grouped holdout artifacts exist. Training is no longer blocked by missing required anchor mappings.
conclusion.what_is_not_done: The model is not scientifically accepted or deployable: the mechanistic run still lacks full correlated scenario uncertainty and joint p10/p50/p90 propagation, the PyAEZ challenger has not been evaluated, and several lower-bound records are containment diagnostics rather than exact surrounding-land targets.
conclusion.next_gate: Complete scenario and joint uncertainty propagation, rerun physical and grouped holdout audits with shared-bundle grouping, repair scale-anchor metadata, then freeze only if all interval/lower-bound and invariant gates remain valid.
